import { execSync, spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';

// ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
execSync('bunx oxfmt generated.mjs');
// ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
execSync('prettier --write generated.css');
// ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
childProcess.exec('uv run black generated.py', callback);
// ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
spawnSync('black', ['generated.py']);
// ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
execFileSync('rustfmt', ['generated.rs']);
// ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
execSync(`taplo fmt Cargo.toml`);
// ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
execFile('black', ['generated.py'], callback);
// ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
spawn('shfmt', ['-w', 'generated.sh']);
